organic_growth.term_used: none - Befesa does not report organic/LFL growth; reported revenue growth shown

organic_growth.rate_effect_note: Revenue EUR 604.3m. No M&A (organic = reported less FX, INFERENCE).
Revenue EUR 821.6m; includes American Zinc Recycling (AZR, consolidated from Aug-2021) - acquisition contribution not separately extracted; zinc price recovery.
Revenue EUR 1,136.0m (per AR2023 comparative); full-year AZR plus high zinc/alu prices.
Revenue EUR 1,182.6m: Steel Dust 799.7 (2024: 825.6), Salt Slags 114.0, Secondary Aluminium 331.3, eliminations -62.4. No M&A; price/volume not disclosed as a bridge.

latest_interim.note: Revenue EUR 901.1m (+1.0%); Q3 +7.4%. Adj. EBITDA 191.8m (+10.4%). Driven by LME zinc (avg ,512 vs ,768) and alu FMB prices; EAF steel dust throughput -0.5% (Q3 -12.1%), utilisation 67.8% (68.7%). No acquisitions -> reported growth is effectively organic + FX (INFERENCE). FY26 adj. EBITDA guidance narrowed to EUR 260-270m incl. EUR 26m US critical-minerals grant in Q4.

geography.note: Revenue by geographical area (note 5), EUR 1,182.6m: US 301.7 (25.5%; 2024 30%); Spain 240.8 (20.4%); Germany 124.0 (10.5%); Belgium 57.4; Finland 52.5; Netherlands 41.4; Italy 40.7; France 38.4; Norway 36.5; Portugal 19.4; Sweden 19.1; Switzerland 14.3; Poland 13.0; Rest of Europe 37.4 (Europe total 734.8 = 62.1%); South Korea 32.1; Australia 30.9; Japan 24.6; Brazil 19.3; China 15.4 (1.3%); RoW 23.8. UK not separately disclosed (within Rest of Europe). Customer concentration: largest customer ~34% of group revenue, second ~11% (Steel Dust).

cash_flow_check.ocf_note: OCF starts from profit before tax and adds back finance costs (35.4) less interest income (10.4): i.e. interest is NOT deducted in OCF. Taxes paid -21.2 are in OCF. WC change net -7.8 (receivables +23.4, inventories -4.2, payables -27.0).
cash_flow_check.lease_note: No separate lease line in the statement; lease payments are INFERRED to sit within 'Cash outflows from bank borrowings and other liabilities (Note 14)' -34.1 (financing). Lease liabilities are small (EUR 21.8m non-current + 11.3m current), so lease principal ~EUR 10-12m/yr (INFERENCE).
cash_flow_check.capex_note: PP&E 73.8 + intangibles 2.3. 9M-26 capex 55.3 (Bernburg growth capex largely complete).
cash_flow_check.factoring: Non-recourse factoring derecognised: EUR 59.9m outstanding at 31-Dec-2025 (2024: 61.5m) - stable, so ~-1.6m effect on 2025 OCF; reverse factoring (supplier) EUR 1.8m. Not a material driver of 2025 FCF.
cash_flow_check.gap_explanation: Lead's ~8% FCF yield uses OCF that is pre-interest. Deducting cash interest (33.7, financing) and leases cuts FCF by ~one third (to ~EUR 90m, i.e. ~5-5.5% on the same market value - INFERENCE). Factoring and working capital are not material; capex was depressed relative to growth needs (US expansion largely done). 2026 benefits from lower interest after deleveraging and a one-off US grant.

claim_checks.finding: Q3-26 presentation: 'China continue running at low utilisation rates and break-even earnings'; Asian volumes -18% YoY in 9M-26; Korea load factor 70%. Group steel-dust utilisation 67.8% 9M-26; company targets 90% by 2028 from <70% in 2025. China plant-level % not disclosed. China = 1.3% of revenue but EUR 77.3m of PP&E/intangibles/ROU (2025) - capital tied up at ~breakeven.

claim_checks.claim: Zinc price sensitivity / hedges rolling off at lower prices
claim_checks.finding: Hedge book provides visibility to Q3-2029 at rising prices: ~,990/t 2026, ~,000 2027, ~,100 2028, ~,200 2029. LME averaged ,830 in Q3-26 vs hedge ,972, so the near-term risk is capped upside rather than roll-off at lower prices; blended price EUR 2,723/t vs hedged 2,561 (9M-26). Downside risk only if LME falls below ~,000 after hedges.

claim_checks.claim: Net leverage >3x is a thesis breaker
claim_checks.finding: Net leverage 2.16x at 30-Sep-2026 (2.59x Sep-25), net debt EUR 563.7m; company expects <2.0x by YE-2026.
